title: UAS Overflight — Spillway Hoist House Proximity

fields.organization: Cedar Valley Water Authority — Security Division
fields.location: Spillway Hoist House crest, near Door P-7 (west)
fields.summary: Visual confirmation of UAS 9X-7F23 passing within 100 ft of the Spillway Hoist House control panel. Drone has black tail with red stripe. Movement was slow and deliberate, consistent with surveillance. No sound heard. No operator seen on ground. No physical contact or interference with infrastructure.

findings.notes: No damage observed at the hoist house access gate or surrounding fencing.
No unauthorized access or tampering noted on the control panel housing.
Confirmed visual sighting of drone with remote ID 9X-7F23 within 100 ft of critical control structure.
No visible operator or vehicle in vicinity of the hoist house or Crest Road.
No audible motor or transmission noise detected.
No debris or temporary structures obstructing the view from the hoist house door.
CAM-09 (west abutment) and CAM-07 (Spillway Hoist House) show no gaps in coverage.
Door P-7 remains unobstructed and accessible.
Remote ID confirmed via AeroSentry; drone registered to operator near public boat ramp (0.6 mi upstream, east shore).
No signs of impact or energy discharge on the hoist house or surrounding concrete.

actionsTaken: Reported visual confirmation to Security Manager via radio at 09:10
Documented drone description and flight path in field log
Notified Control Room of UAS proximity per EAP 4.2
recommendations: File formal report in Security Incident Log (Log ID: S-2026-0413)
Initiate UAS threat assessment per Security Plan Section 6.4
Notify Pike County Sheriff's Office and FAA per EAP 5.2
fields.photosNote: 6 photos attached: IMG_0413-0418 (drone profile, control panel proximity, 100-ft range estimate, east abutment, boat ramp area, CAM-09 feed), all timestamped 09:08-09:10

imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance on the crest road of a concrete dam: spillway gate hoists, an intake tower, a white service pickup truck, the reservoir on one side and a steep wooded valley on the other. Phone snapshot taken from ground level at the Cedar Ridge Dam overlook, focusing on the sky above the dam crest. A small, dark drone is visible in the mid-distance, partially obscured by leafy tree branches. The background shows the reservoir below, the dam's concrete spillway, and distant recreational boats on the water. The sky is overcast with soft daylight, and the image has a slight tilt and flash glare from the phones hand, visible at the lower edge, wearing a baseball cap and holding a fishing rod. The screen is plain, unbranded, and slightly smudged.
